public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>H<sub>2</sub>O and E=mc<sup>2</sup></p>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result);

}
